entities.summary: Ukraine, a notable figure in the history of Belarus, associated with Independence & Lukashenko's Authoritarian Rule (2006–2026). Preceded by Early Independence & Lukashenko's Rise. Their legacy influenced 2020 mass protests against fraudulent presidential election and Belarus used as staging ground for Russia's Ukraine invasion.
